integrity: All mathematical claims in this package concern the same parity-resolved second-order asymptotic. The numerical checker is a finite diagnostic and not the basis of the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Real uniform Boolean cube; homogeneous degree-three Walsh subspace; asymptotic remainder o(sqrt(n)) without an explicit global finite-size error bound. Earlier literature already proves the exact expectation and the leading n^(3/2) term. The degree-two lattice-phase comparison is available at summary level only; unindexed equivalent results remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Two lattice phases and a strict parity gap in cubic Boolean projection constants
